description:
El Lissitzky's posters and graphic design to 1930, including Beat the Whites with the Red Wedge. Real public-domain works from open-access collections, each with title, date, medium, holding institution, credit, licence, source page and full-resolution link; the first comes back as an image.

Example questions:
- "Show me Soviet constructivist posters"
- "El Lissitzky Red Wedge poster"
- "Russian avant-garde graphic design"

limit.description: How many works to list (1-10, default 5).

narrow.description: Optional extra words to narrow the theme (a place, year or motif).

name: constructivist_posters
title: Constructivist Posters (El Lissitzky)
